title: PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the exemption of three positions for the Community and Investment Department (CID) from the Civil Service…
text:
[Council File 23-1313]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PERSONNEL AND HIRING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the exemption of three positions for the Community and Investment Department (CID) from the Civil Service pursuant to Charter Section 1001(d)(4).
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the exemption of the following positions from the Civil Service for the CID pursuant to Charter Section 1001(d)(4):
Project Coordinator (Class Code 1537); Position No. P167073
Project Coordinator (Class Code 1537); Position No. P167074
Chief Grants Coordinator (Class Code 9182); Position No. P167128
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the CID. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is asked to exempt three Community and Investment Department positions, two Project Coordinators and a Chief Grants Coordinator, from civil service.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026)
